title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ProductOfferingRiskAssessment
description: This is a task resource allowing assessment of the risks associated with a product offering. For example, the risk associated with iPhone X will probably be higher than the risk for a battery (TM Forum TMF696 Risk Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition ProductOfferingRiskAssessment; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOfferingRiskAssessment:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ProductOfferingRiskAssessment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

productOffering.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF696_RiskManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF696-RiskManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductOfferingRiskAssessment/properties/productOffering'. The product offering for which the assessment is to be carried out, must be supplied as input to the task, with the attribute id populated. In TMF this is a ProductOfferingRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ProductOffering entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOffering:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
